errors.evidence: The chart is a simple bar chart with nine distinct categories. There are no visual cues such as spacing, brackets, or color-coding to indicate that any of the bars are grouped. This is an incorrect description of the chart's visual structure.

The description only gives the minimum (-1,5) and maximum (9,5) values and summarizes the rest. It omits the specific, labeled values for the other seven data points (7,8; 1,6; 5,5; 4,8; 3,6; 6,6; 5,3), which are key information presented in the chart.

The description does not mention that the horizontal axis, which represents the values, has no title or specified units. The reference description correctly notes this omission in the original figure.
